title: Longitudinal ICU phenotype clustering
summary: Candidate coordinates for data-driven longitudinal phenotypes. Population, representation, missingness, candidate models and cluster counts, outcome-blind selection, resampling, stability threshold, and reportability must be frozen before execution. Failure of the selected solution is a valid no-stable-phenotype result and cannot trigger post-hoc seed, k, threshold, feature, imputation, or exclusion changes.

design_candidates.population: A reproducibly defined ICU cohort with enough repeated measurements in a common observation window.
design_candidates.time_zero: A shared clinical landmark such as ICU admission or syndrome onset, before trajectory extraction.
design_candidates.observation_window: A fixed longitudinal window and grid with explicit aggregation, missingness, and survivor-selection handling.
design_candidates.prediction_or_followup_window: Outcome comparisons begin after phenotype assignment unless outcomes are strictly descriptive labels.
eligibility_candidates: Prespecify minimum measurement support and survivor-selection reporting
Freeze the candidate model family, k set, and outcome-blind selection hierarchy
Separate local discovery from external reproducibility
design_candidates.exposure: Unsupervised phenotype assignment derived only from prespecified longitudinal features.
design_candidates.outcome: A prespecified stability decision, including no stable solution, plus secondary clinical outcomes never used to choose the model or cluster count.
design_candidates.estimand: Whether the frozen representation and selection protocol identifies an internally stable phenotype solution; only after acceptance may assignments support descriptive outcome contrasts.
recommended_methods: Outcome-blind candidate selection followed by a separately frozen stability gate
Complete bootstrap or subsampling assignment-stability ledger with a prespecified failure action
External reproducibility using the same frozen representation and assignment protocol
sensitivity_analyses: Separately versioned feature-scaling or model-family designs reviewed before execution
Separately versioned observation-window or grid designs reviewed before execution
External-database reproduction without tuning the discovery solution

stop_conditions: Repeated measurements cannot be aligned to the frozen landmark and representation
Model or cluster number selection uses outcome association
The selected solution fails a prespecified cluster-size, refit-completeness, or stability threshold; report no stable phenotype solution without rescue
requires_confirmation: Confirm population, representation, missingness, model family, k set, selection, resampling, threshold, and reportability before clustering
Confirm that outcomes will not select or rescue the solution and that external reproducibility remains a separate requirement
